# OneKash Labs

> OneKash Labs makes private, open-source apps: no ads, no tracking, nothing collected. It also helps people learn to build their own app, customize an open-source app (where its license allows), and run its apps for a team.

Full text for AI assistants: https://onekash.org/llms-full.txt

## Apps

- [KashCal](https://kashcal.onekash.org): all your calendars in one private Android app. iCloud, CalDAV, ICS subscriptions, and the phone's own calendars. Works offline.
- [KashPass](https://kashpass.onekash.org): open and edit your KeePass vault on Android. No internet permission.
- [KashCake](https://kashcake.onekash.org): birthday and anniversary reminders from your contacts on Android. No internet access.
- [iCloud Calendar MCP](https://mcp.onekash.org): an MCP server that gives AI agents read and write access to iCloud Calendar over CalDAV.

## Each app's own files for AI assistants

- KashCal: https://kashcal.onekash.org/llms.txt and https://kashcal.onekash.org/llms-full.txt
- KashPass: https://kashpass.onekash.org/llms.txt and https://kashpass.onekash.org/llms-full.txt
- KashCake: https://kashcake.onekash.org/llms.txt and https://kashcake.onekash.org/llms-full.txt
- iCloud Calendar MCP: https://mcp.onekash.org/llms.txt and https://mcp.onekash.org/llms-full.txt

## Work with us

- Learn to build your own app: a bootcamp from first screen to app store. Waitlist open.
- An open-source app with your name on it: your colours and features, where the license allows.
- Our apps for your team: we set them up and help your team use them.
- Contact: the Contact us button on https://onekash.org
